scripts.build:lib: tsc -b packages/core packages/sdk packages/content packages/cli packages/mcp packages/adapters-node
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build --workspace @statebeats/player
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && prettier --check packages tests scripts *.json *.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build:lib && npm run dev --workspace @statebeats/player
scripts.demo: npm run build:lib && node packages/cli/dist/index.js demo
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
